text: 检索的九九分位时延必须压在四分之一秒以内。
evidence: 制度/时延与容量.md: 检索服务的 p99 时延预算是 250 毫秒。
note: 九九分位 is p99, and 250 milliseconds is a quarter of a second. 以内 means within that budget.

text: 账单服务的 p99 时延预算是四分之一秒。
evidence: 制度/时延与容量.md: 账单服务的 p99 时延预算是 800 毫秒。
note: Billing p99 is 800 milliseconds, not 250. The quarter-second budget belongs to search.

text: 下单接口的返回时限是 2 分钟。
evidence: 制度/时延与容量.md: 下单接口必须在 2 秒内返回。
note: The order API must return within 2 seconds, so the limit is not 2 minutes.

text: 检索服务每月的错误预算是请求量的千分之一。
evidence: 制度/时延与容量.md: 检索服务每个自然月的错误预算是请求量的 0.1%。
note: 0.1 percent is 1/1000, which is 千分之一. 每个自然月 is the monthly budget 每月 refers to.

text: 检索服务每个月允许百分之一的请求失败。
evidence: 制度/时延与容量.md: 检索服务每个自然月的错误预算是请求量的 0.1%。
note: The monthly budget is 0.1 percent, not 1 percent (百分之一). The 1 percent figure is the five-minute alert threshold.

text: 检索索引的热数据有半个太比字节。
evidence: 制度/时延与容量.md: 检索索引的热数据占用 512 GiB。
note: 太比字节 is tebibyte; half of one is 512 GiB. The same file treats GB and GiB as different (500 GB is about 466 GiB). This restates the 512 GiB claim and conflicts with the 512 GB claim.

text: 检索索引的热数据占用五百一十二吉比字节。
evidence: 制度/时延与容量.md: 检索索引的热数据占用 512 GiB。
note: 五百一十二吉比字节 is 512 GiB, the same quantity as half a tebibyte. It conflicts with the 512 GB claim.

text: 检索索引的热数据占了 512 GB。
evidence: 制度/时延与容量.md: 检索索引的热数据占用 512 GiB。
note: Hot search data occupies 512 GiB, not 512 GB. The invoice sentence converts 500 GB into about 466 GiB, so the two units differ here. Conflicts with the half-tebibyte and 512 GiB claims.

text: 账单归档有 500 GiB。
evidence: 制度/时延与容量.md: 账单归档保存的发票合计 500 GB，大约相当于 466 GiB。
note: The archive is 500 GB, about 466 GiB, not 500 GiB.

text: 检索热数据保留 90 天。
evidence: 制度/时延与容量.md: 检索热数据保留 14 天。
note: Hot search data is kept 14 days. 90 days is the cold-snapshot retention. This conflicts with the claim that hot data is currently kept 30 days.

text: 检索热数据目前保留 30 天。
evidence: 制度/时延与容量.md: 检索热数据保留 14 天。
note: Current retention is 14 days. 30 days is only the 2026-03-02 plan. 目前 is a relative time with no date in the claim. Conflicts with the 90-day claim.

text: 2026年3月2日容量组曾打算让检索热数据保留三十天。
evidence: 记录/2026-03-02-保留计划.md: 2026年3月2日，容量组的计划是把检索热数据保留 30 天。
note: 曾打算 and 三十天 restate that day's plan to keep hot data for 30 days. Later retention of 14 days does not erase the plan. 2026-03-02 is 220 days before 2026-10-08.

text: 账单渲染的网关超时是 1500 毫秒。
evidence: 决策/ADR-011-超时与重试.md: 账单渲染的网关超时是 8 秒。
note: Billing renders time out at 8 seconds. 1500 milliseconds is the search-query timeout, and 1500 ms is 1.5 seconds, not 8.

text: 所有网关超时都是 1500 毫秒。
evidence: 决策/ADR-011-超时与重试.md: 账单渲染的网关超时是 8 秒。
note: Billing renders use 8 seconds, so not every gateway timeout is 1500 milliseconds. 所有 is absolute wording.

text: 已经成功的检索查询不得再发一次。
evidence: 决策/ADR-011-超时与重试.md: 已经返回 HTTP 200 的检索查询不得重试。
note: HTTP 200 is success, and 不得再发一次 restates 不得重试. The negations agree.

text: 检索查询成功之后已经不再重试。
evidence: 决策/ADR-011-超时与重试.md: 2026年7月22日之前，检索查询即使返回了 HTTP 200 也会被重试。
note: Before 2026-07-22 a search query was retried even after HTTP 200, and ADR-011 now says such a query 不得重试, so retries have stopped (不再). ADR-004 only records the old 800 ms timeout.

text: 账单渲染不得重试。
evidence: 决策/ADR-011-超时与重试.md: 账单渲染最多重试一次，且仅当第一次返回 HTTP 503 时才允许重试。
note: A billing render may be retried once when the first response is HTTP 503. The ban applies to successful search queries.

text: 账单渲染只有第一次返回 HTTP 503 时才能重试。
evidence: 决策/ADR-011-超时与重试.md: 账单渲染最多重试一次，且仅当第一次返回 HTTP 503 时才允许重试。
note: 只有…才 restates 仅当: a retry is allowed only when the first response is HTTP 503. The claim does not deny the one-retry cap.

text: 账单值班不得确认检索告警。
evidence: 会议纪要/2026-09-18-容量会.md: 检索告警不得由账单值班确认。
note: Same ban, active versus passive. The negations agree.

text: 检索值班不得确认账单告警。
note: The meeting only bars the billing rotation from acknowledging a search alert. It does not say whether the search rotation may acknowledge a billing alert, and the negation does not decide that converse.
